fluff.overview: Warrior House Dai Da Chi, the most bellicose of the Capellan Warrior House orders, has trained an elite squad of snipers armed with the Minolta 9000 Advanced Sniper System. Originally custom-built for the Death Commandos, the Minolta 9000 is a precision instrument capable of eliminating targets at extreme range with minimal signature. These seven-trooper squads operate on foot with camo sneak suits, relying on fieldcraft and patience rather than speed or firepower. Dai Da Chi snipers have fought on several Republic worlds, building a grim reputation for identifying and eliminating enemy commanders. RAF forces along the Capellan front have been forced to devote significant counter-sniper resources in response to confirmed kills attributed to these squads.
